About the Company
Turning marketing into a market-domination weapon, we created a new category - the marketplace for future customers. Businesses shop for leads as they shop for products in e-commerce: full transparency, control, and predictable outcomes. We are the #1 lead marketplace in the USA, and we are accelerating.
Role Overview
We are looking for an Outbound Calling Officer to proactively contact property owners, buyers, sellers, investors, landlords, and tenants, and turn those conversations into qualified opportunities.
This role is not about "making calls." It is about disciplined outbound prospecting, sharp qualification, accurate CRM documentation, and timely follow-up - at high volume, without losing quality. The core performance standard is a minimum of 300 outbound call attempts per working day.
Requirements

• High school / intermediate qualification, bachelor's degree, or equivalent education

• 2-3 years of experience in outbound calling, telesales, telemarketing, customer service, lead generation, or appointment setting

• Neutral US accent and confident, professional phone communication with US-based leads

• Experience in real estate, property acquisition, brokerage, mortgage, or investor lead generation is highly desirable

• Excellent verbal communication, active listening, questioning, and objection-handling skills

• Comfort working with CRM systems, dialers, spreadsheets, and productivity tools

• Ability to sustain high-volume outbound activity in a target-driven environment while maintaining accuracy and professionalism

What You'll Be Doing
Outbound prospecting & lead generation

• Make a minimum of 300 outbound call attempts per working day using the company-approved dialer, CRM, and lead lists

• Contact prospective buyers, sellers, property owners, investors, landlords, tenants, and other assigned real estate leads

• Use approved scripts and talk tracks while keeping a natural, professional, consultative conversation style

• Present the company and its services accurately, identify interest, and establish the appropriate next step

• Generate qualified opportunities and transfer or assign them to the relevant Representative

• Schedule property discussions and callbacks in line with campaign requirements

Lead qualification

• Ask structured discovery questions to determine property ownership, location, property type, transaction objective, motivation, timeline, and decision-making authority

• Capture pricing expectations, property condition, financing status, and preferred communication method where relevant

• Distinguish qualified, nurture, callback, disqualified, and do-not-contact outcomes per the approved qualification framework

• Escalate high-intent or time-sensitive opportunities promptly

CRM, follow-up & data management

• Disposition 100% of completed call attempts and record accurate notes for meaningful conversations

• Update contact, property, qualification, callback, and appointment information immediately after each interaction

• Complete scheduled callbacks and follow-ups within the committed timeframe

• Maintain confidentiality and protect customer, property, and company information

Communication & compliance

• Communicate clearly and confidently, including when handling rejection, objections, or difficult conversations

• Use approved objection-handling techniques without misleading, exaggerated, or unverified representations

• Observe company policies, consent requirements, do-not-contact procedures, data privacy controls, and telemarketing rules for the relevant market

• Participate in coaching, call calibration, quality reviews, and product training, and apply feedback consistently

How Performance Is Measured
Performance is assessed through a balanced combination of activity, quality, conversion, data discipline, and schedule compliance.

Our customers run their busiest weeks of the year on HubSync , and our test pipeline has to be something they can count on: when a pipeline is red, it means something real; when it is green, the team trusts it enough to ship.
Our test framework is AI-assisted by design. Engineers define what a test should check, Claude Code writes the test code under versioned skill-file rules, and a convention linter plus tiered CI gates (PR, deploy, and nightly) hold the standard. The architecture is settled. This person will own it, extend it, and help the rest of engineering use it well. Success is measured by how many people contribute strong tests, not by how many tests this person writes.
Key Responsibilities
Gate & Signal Ownership

• Triage CI failures to root cause, so every gate failure gets a real disposition instead of a re-run.

• Run test quarantine with discipline: flaky tests go in with a tracking ticket and an owner, and come back out fixed or deleted.

• Lead the quarterly review of the PR gate so only tests that earn their place stay in it.

• Protect signal quality over green builds; a gate that passes because tests were skipped or deleted is a failed gate.

Framework Engineering

• Own and extend the shared test framework: fixtures, factories, the API client, page object conventions, and CI test mapping.

• Lead the move of the convention linter from shell-based checks to AST-aware tooling.

• Build reusable patterns for hard problems, such as complex grid assertions and external signing ceremonies, so feature teams don't have to solve them again.

AI-Assisted Test Development

• Own the skills system that governs AI-written tests; design the rules that define what the model may write and what it must refuse.

• Trace violations in AI-written tests back to their source and fix them in the skill files, not in review comments.

• Re-validate those rules whenever the underlying model changes.

• Review generated tests for convention compliance and real test value.

L’IMT Nord Europe est une école sous tutelle du ministère de l’économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique. IMT Nord Europe est née en 2017 de la fusion de Télécom Lille et de l’École des Mines de Douai. Elle compte aujourd’hui parmi les plus Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs au Nord de Paris avec plus 2200 élèves, dont un quart d’apprentis, plus de 600 diplômés par an et un réseau de 15 000 diplômés. Elle fait partie de l’Institut Mines Télécom, premier groupe public de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France, et est partenaire de l’université de Lille.
